propositions: Configuration resolution must establish one immutable OperationSnapshot per operation boundary with strict precedence (explicit input > environment > project config > user config > schema default) without rereading ambient state mid-operation
Repository root resolution must separate from config composition (explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/cwd) and interpret relative paths against the winning root

Provider-native authentication must compose through subsystem-local GitRuntime, LLMRuntime, and BridgeRuntime bindings that preserve SDK-owned credential lifecycles without arbitrary injection or second scheduler paths

Static credentials must be represented only as provider-specific non-serializable Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes carriers revealed only in sending adapters, with no universal secret broker or application-owned cloud retrieval

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before queue/worker/network creation, copy into 0700/0600 process-owned files, and rotate only on restart/redeploy

An AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject direct/aliased reads/reloads below approved seams, permit only exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover
